summary: Carrier Global filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $1.5 billion two-tranche senior notes offering: $750 million 5.000% notes due 2029 priced at 99.336% and $750 million 5.350% notes due 2033 priced at 98.438%, settling T+2 on November 4, 2026. Net proceeds refinance existing indebtedness, including repayment at maturity of the 2.493% notes due 2027, with remainder for general corporate and commercial paper repayment. Notes are unsecured, rank pari passu, carry a 101% change-of-control put, and are unlisted. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation; watch refinancing spread economics and any change-of-control covenant implications.
